title: Blueberry Muffins
description: Soft, domed blueberry muffins with a crunchy sugar top, made in one bowl with melted butter, yogurt and plenty of berries.
scaleNote: One standard 12-cup muffin tin holds a single batch. Bake a double batch in two tins on the same rack if they fit, or one after the other.

image.alt: Three blueberry muffins with sugary tops

ingredients.note: fresh, or frozen straight from the freezer

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven} with a rack in the middle. Line the muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until pale and slightly thick, about {time 1 min notimer}. Whisk in the melted butter, yogurt and vanilla.
Add the flour mixture and fold with a spatula until only a few streaks of flour remain. Fold in the blueberries gently, just until no dry flour shows.
Divide the batter among the cups; they will be full. Sprinkle the tops with the extra sugar.
Bake until domed and golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean, {time 20-24 min}. Cool in the tin for {time 5 min}, then move the muffins to a rack.

notes: Don’t thaw frozen blueberries; they bleed less if they go in frozen. Add 2 to 3 minutes to the baking time.
Muffins keep in a covered container for 2 days, or frozen for up to 3 months.
